```{r}
test <- open_matrix_dir(dir = "~/hpchome/final.counts.disk")
meta<- readRDS("~/hpchome/meta.rds")

asdf <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = test, meta = meta)

asdf@reductions$harmony.full <- readRDS("~/hpchome/harmony.full.rds")
asdf@reductions$full.umap <- readRDS("~/hpchome/full.umap.rds")
asdf@assays$sketch <- readRDS("~/hpchome/sketch.assay.rds")

Idents(asdf) <- asdf$orig.ident

DefaultAssay(asdf) <- "RNA"
asdf <- NormalizeData(asdf)

DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "celltype", label = T)+NoLegend()
```


```{r}
`%!in%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABGD][VDJ]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ig_genes  <- grep("^IG[HKL][VDJ]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ribo  <- grep("^RP[SL]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
cell.cycle <- c(s.genes, g2m.genes)
hemoglobin <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
```


```{r}
table(asdf$celltype)
```


```{r}
stromal <- subset(asdf, celltype %in% c("Fibroblasts", "Glandular_Epi", "Keratinocytes", "Lymph_Endo", "Melanocytes", "Pericytes", "Vasc_Endo", "Neurons") & Tissue != "blood")
table(stromal$Tissue)

DefaultAssay(stromal) <- "RNA"
stromal@assays$sketch <- NULL

table(stromal$GEO.Cohort)
table(stromal$orig.ident)

stromal <- Split_Layers(stromal, assay = "RNA", split.by = "GEO.Cohort")
stromal <- FindVariableFeatures(stromal, nfeatures = 2000)
vf <- VariableFeatures(stromal)

vf.ss <- setdiff(vf, c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, hemoglobin, cell.cycle, ribo))

VariableFeatures(stromal) <- vf.ss

table(stromal$GEO.Cohort)
stromal <- subset(stromal, GEO.Cohort != "Iowa")

stromal <- SketchData(object = stromal, ncells = 5000, method = "LeverageScore", sketched.assay = "sketch", over.write = T)
DefaultAssay(stromal) <- "sketch"

stromal <- JoinLayers(stromal, assay = "sketch")
stromal <- FindVariableFeatures(stromal, nfeatures = 2000)

vf <- VariableFeatures(stromal)
vf.ss <- setdiff(vf, c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, hemoglobin, cell.cycle, ribo))
VariableFeatures(stromal) <- vf.ss

stromal <- ScaleData(stromal)
stromal <- RunPCA(stromal)
stromal <- RunHarmony(stromal, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "sketch", reduction.save = "harmony", dims = 1:30, ncores = 30)
stromal <- RunUMAP(stromal, dims = 1:30, return.model = T, reduction = "harmony", umap.method = "umap-learn")

DimPlot(stromal, group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(stromal, group.by = "GEO.Cohort")
DimPlot(stromal, group.by = "celltype", label = T)+NoLegend()

```

```{r}
stromal <- FindNeighbors(stromal, reduction = "umap", dims = 1:2)
stromal <- FindClusters(stromal, resolution = c(0.01,0.05,0.2))

stromal <- FindNeighbors(stromal, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
stromal <- FindClusters(stromal, resolution = c(0.1,0.3,0.5,0.8,1))
```

                    sketched.assay = "sketch",

```{r}
markers.stromal <- FindAllMarkers(stromal, min.pct = .1, only.pos = T, group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.1")

markers.stromal$dif <- markers.stromal$pct.1 - markers.stromal$pct.2
markers.stromal.ss <- markers.stromal %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(desc(dif)) %>% slice_head(n = 20)
```




```{r}
stromal <- subset(stromal, sketch_snn_res.0.5 != "5")
remove <- CellSelector(DimPlot(stromal, reduction = "full.umap.1"))
stromal <- subset(stromal, barcode.unique %!in% remove)

DimPlot(stromal, reduction = "full.umap.1", group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.5", label = T, raster = F, pt.size = .01, alpha = .1)+NoLegend()
```

```{r}
Idents(stromal) <- stromal$sketch_snn_res.0.5

markers.stromal <- FindAllMarkers(stromal, only.pos = T, min.pct = .1, max.cells.per.ident = 5000)
markers.stromal$dif <- markers.stromal$pct.1 - markers.stromal$pct.2
markers.stromal.ss <- markers.stromal %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(desc(dif)) %>% slice_head(n = 10)

markers.stromal.ss$cluster <- as.numeric(as.character(markers.stromal.ss$cluster))
markers.stromal.ss <- arrange(markers.stromal.ss, cluster)
```

```{r}
mat.stromal <- stromal@assays$RNA@layers$counts
rownames(mat.stromal) <- rownames(stromal)
colnames(mat.stromal) <- colnames(stromal)

write_matrix_dir(mat = mat.stromal, dir = "~/hpchome/stromal.mat.matrix.dir")

saveRDS(stromal@assays$sketch, "~/hpchome/stromal.sketch.assay.rds")
saveRDS(stromal@reductions$harmony.full, "~/hpchome/stromal.harmony.full.rds")
saveRDS(stromal@reductions$full.umap.1, "~/hpchome/stromal.full.umap.rds")

meta <- stromal@meta.data
meta <- meta[,c(1:35,53)]
saveRDS(meta, "~/hpchome/stromal.meta.rds")
```
